name: Robin Hood
source:
Master archer. Respected leader. Charming scoundrel. These are perhaps the most complimentary descriptions heard for Robin of Locksley, a lord who lost his land and title for rebelling against Nottingham's government. Though his convictions are strong, he's also an inveterate tease who refuses to take most things seriously. Will he change his ways when his life and love are on the line?

Strengths: Archery, oratory, intelligence, charm
Flaws: Flippant, cocky, weak to the Sheriff's provocations

Likes: King Richard, beautiful women, clever banter
Dislikes: The Sheriff, tyranny, stuffiness
